conclusion.rationale: The patch additively expands the accepted values for term_start() term_finish option from {'open','close'} to {'open','close','noclose'}. No existing behavior is broken: open/close continue to work identically, invalid values still produce E475 errors. The new 'noclose' value provides additional functionality (keeping the terminal buffer hidden/listed/loaded after job completion). All tests pass, 100% patch line coverage is achieved (2/2 executable lines), and zero contract breaches were detected in both before and after builds.
recommended_actions: No blocking issues found. The patch is safe to apply.
Existing terminal tests continue to pass with no regressions.
If any Vimscript plugins validate term_finish values with hard-coded lists, they may need updating to include 'noclose'.
